model_identity.served_by: llama-server version 0.3.0-dev (build 10645, commit c5fc7e348), built with Clang 20.1.8 for Windows x86_64
model_identity.note: a model swap is a NEW ARM, not an upgrade -- it gets its own registration

PREREGISTRATION.cost_model: turnover_t = sum_i |w_{t,i} - w_{t-1,i}| with w_{-1} = 0; cost_t = turnover_t * COST_BPS_PER_SIDE / 1e4; net_t = gross_t - cost_t. A full monthly replacement of a gross-1 long-short is turnover 2.0, i.e. 50 bps a month or ~6%/yr, and that is the number to sanity-check against

question: Given only that month's ANONYMISED news, does a local 7B call the next month's SPY-adjusted direction better than the identical pipeline reading a digest from a random other month -- on a panel the 135-name read never saw?
does_not_restate: PANEL-A (2015-2024, 135 names) keeps exactly the claim its own amendment gave it; this receipt is a separate experiment

construction.convention: enter at the first open of M+1, exit at the first open of M+2, minus SPY over the same two opens

POWER_FIRST.note: the unit is the monthly date block, not the cell: names inside one month share the market and are not independent draws

masking.note: a document with no masked token is one where neither the ticker nor an issuer-name token appeared in its text -- common for a headline that never names the company -- but a HIGH rate of them would be a mask leak

cost_model.charged_on: realised turnover sum|dw| per monthly rebalance

cost_bound_before_the_read.why: each month's weights satisfy sum|w| = 1, so sum_i |w_t,i - w_t-1,i| <= 2 however different the two months are
cost_bound_before_the_read.reading: the levels cannot lose more than 6%/yr to costs and the difference cannot move by more than 6%/yr either -- and it will move by far less, because the arm and the control rebalance the same cells on the same dates. The bound is arithmetic; the realised numbers are measured by the read and printed beside the gross ones

AMNESIA_canary.reading: a POSITIVE gap means the model does better when it can see who the company is: recall, not reading

cost_cancellation.reading: the two books rebalance identically on the same dates, so the cost line cancels in the DIFFERENCE to the extent the turnovers match; the levels are NOT cost-robust and are reported gross beside net

headline: PANEL-B 19 blocks: masked read 0.712%/yr gross / -3.513%/yr net vs shuffled control 1.136 / -3.253 -> -0.424 gross, -0.26 net, t -0.097; AMNESIA gap 0.0027
verdict: REJECT (registered clause): net difference -0.26%/yr, t -0.097, arm net -3.513%/yr vs control net -3.253%/yr.
